raw_response:
This plot no be my own, I dey rent am, so I no wan waste money on chemical fertilizer for cassava and yam — dem no really need am for this our soil wey still get small bush fallow. I go gather household refuse and small ash from the kitchen to put for the yam mounds, and I go use the cassava stems and yam setts wey I keep from last harvest. The rain dey plenty here for South South, so no need for irrigation, and pest no too worry root crops. I go do most of the work myself, but for clearing and making mounds I go call one or two young men to help me for a few days.
